name: web-check
description: Web-Check is an open-source OSINT tool for analysing websites and domains. It provides information about IP addresses, SSL certificates, DNS records, cookies, HTTP headers, domain information, crawl rules, redirects, open ports, traceroute, DNS security, performance, trackers, associated hostnames and other website intelligence. Web-Check works without any API key for its core functionality. Optional API keys can be configured to enable additional checks and enrichment from external services.

ports.name: HTTP Port
ports.description: Port used to access the Web-Check web interface.

variables.name: Host
variables.description: Network interface on which Web-Check listens. The default value is 0.0.0.0.

variables.name: Google Cloud API Key
variables.description: Optional Google Cloud API key used by Web-Check for additional checks.

variables.name: Shodan API Key
variables.description: Optional Shodan API key used by Web-Check for additional host and hostname information.

variables.name: WhoAPI API Key
variables.description: Optional WhoAPI key used by Web-Check for additional WHOIS information.

variables.name: SecurityTrails API Key
variables.description: Optional SecurityTrails API key used by Web-Check for additional domain and IP information.

variables.name: URLScan API Key
variables.description: Optional URLScan API key used by Web-Check for additional URL intelligence.

variables.name: Cloudmersive API Key
variables.description: Optional Cloudmersive API key used by Web-Check for additional security and threat intelligence checks.

variables.name: Tranco Username
variables.description: Optional Tranco username used for traffic ranking checks.

variables.name: Tranco API Key
variables.description: Optional Tranco API key used for traffic ranking checks.

variables.name: Torrent IP API Key
variables.description: Optional Torrent IP API key used for additional IP intelligence.

variables.name: BuiltWith API Key
variables.description: Optional BuiltWith API key used for additional website technology information.

variables.name: API Rate Limit
variables.description: Enable rate limiting for Web-Check API requests.

variables.name: API Timeout
variables.description: Maximum timeout for Web-Check API requests, in milliseconds.

variables.name: API CORS Origin
variables.description: Optional allowed origin for Web-Check API CORS requests.

variables.name: Disabled Checks
variables.description: Optional comma-separated list of Web-Check checks to disable.

variables.name: Enabled Checks
variables.description: Optional comma-separated list of checks to enable exclusively.

variables.name: Blocked Hosts
variables.description: Optional comma-separated list of hosts or networks that Web-Check must never scan.

variables.name: Trust Proxy
variables.description: Optional proxy trust configuration when Web-Check is running behind a reverse proxy such as Traefik or Nginx.
